title: Annotatio VI §.VIII: not means of salvation but means of greater judgment for the Impious
pass_a_gloss: And so further the Dissensus is not thus far about means of salvation — Oral Eating of Christ’s body being by itself apt and born to confer Salvation on no one, much less on the unworthy — but only about means of greater judgment and condemnation, at least as concerns the Impious.
pass_b_english: So the dissensus is not about means of salvation — Oral eating by itself saves no one, least of all the unworthy.
It is about means of greater judgment and condemnation, at least for the Impious.
source_text: Eóque porrò Dissensus eatenus non est de mediis salutis, Orali corporis Christi Manducatione per se Salutem nemini, nedum indigno, conferre aptâ natáque; Sed de mediis majoris duntaxat judicii & condemnationis, saltem quod ad impios attinet.

lemmas.gloss: is not about means of salvation
